summary: multi-acct forces install-time resolution of a dependency from an attacker-controlled non-registry host with lifecycle scripts enabled
details: package.json and npm-shrinkwrap.json for multi-acct@1.0.0 pin the dependency 'vector-cursor-stream-engine' to a direct tarball URL at https://artifacts.yosiroute.com/npm/vector-cursor-stream-engine — a third-party host unrelated to the npm registry. The shrinkwrap entry for that dependency has hasInstallScript: true, so npm will fetch the tarball from artifacts.yosiroute.com and execute its lifecycle scripts (preinstall/install/postinstall) on the installer's machine as a side effect of `npm install multi-acct`. The multi-acct package body is otherwise a trivial name/version export, making the shrinkwrap-forced fetch the package's only meaningful install-time effect. Whoever controls artifacts.yosiroute.com controls arbitrary code execution on any host that installs this package, and the tarball contents at that URL are mutable and can be swapped at any time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
